questions.q: In "Know your customer and market Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Review monthly: numbers, defects, complaints, cash. Write three decisions each time.
In food: Food firms register premises and products with the health surveillance bodies; labels need ingredients, allergens, batch and expiry.
Add one proof for each promise: a sample, a test result, a guarantee or a customer record.
Count the market in units: how many cases could one area buy in a month? Use two public sources and your own count, then take the lower figure.

questions.q: In "Rules, registration and data duties in Brazil Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Make a 12-month cash plan. Cash timing matters as much as profit: customers may pay late, suppliers may want money first.
Write the customer in one sentence: a household or retail buyer. Add the place, the moment of need and what they use today.
Price from cost upward and from customer value downward, then pick a price inside both.
Learn the tax regime that fits your size and write down which taxes you will collect and pay, and when.

questions.q: In "Design the offer Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Add one proof for each promise: a sample, a test result, a guarantee or a customer record.
In food: Use hazard analysis and critical control points: list hazards, set limits, monitor, record, correct.
Write who does what in an emergency, and rehearse it once a quarter.
For the top five, choose a control: remove the hazard, replace it, guard it, train people, or use protective gear, in that order of preference.

questions.q: In "Run the work step by step Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Choose one first segment and say why the others wait.
Map the process from first contact to paid and closed. Typical stages: enquiry, quote, preparation, delivery of the case, check, payment, follow-up.
Plan the renewal of licences, equipment and skills a year ahead.
Write a role card for each person: purpose, five tasks, the standard for each, and who to ask for help.

questions.q: In "Safety, quality and risk Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: In food: Pick a channel first: retail shelf, restaurant supply or direct online; each sets pack size and price.
Check that insurance and legal duties match the risk you actually carry.
Write a one-page standard procedure per stage: who, what, tool, time, record.
Price from cost upward and from customer value downward, then pick a price inside both.

questions.q: In "People, skills and service Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Create two options at most, so choice stays easy.
Train by showing, doing with support, then doing alone with a check. Record sign-off per task.
Test the plan: what if sales fall by a quarter, or cost rises by a tenth?
Fix the cause of a defect, not the symptom. Ask 'why' five times and record the answer.

questions.q: In "Money: cost, price and break-even Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: List five rivals or substitutes within reach. For each, record price, strength, weakness and how people reach it.
Ask each customer how they found you, and record it. Spend more where the record shows results.
Create two options at most, so choice stays easy.
Keep money for business and money for the owner apart.

questions.q: In "Grow, measure and renew Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: List five rivals or substitutes within reach. For each, record price, strength, weakness and how people reach it.
Review monthly: numbers, defects, complaints, cash. Write three decisions each time.
Write a one-page standard procedure per stage: who, what, tool, time, record.
Interview at least eight real customers with open questions. Record exact words, not your summary.
